_doc: The only hand-kept part of the coverage map. Everything else comes from Transitous on every run. own_live: cities where the Publit app adds live times from its own sources (not via Transitous); this changes only with the app. partial: areas checked by hand where a kind of service is missing from the open data (gaps: L local and regional buses, C city buses, M metro, T trams, F ferries, S suburban trains); used for the city dots and for the app's warnings (atlas.txt).
